component: Calendar view tablist keyboard and selection state

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Arrow Left/Right move focus with wrapping and RTL direction handling without selecting a new view. Enter, Space and clicks explicitly activate the button value. The selected-view loop updates ariaSelected and one zero tabIndex while the markup gives each tab its matching controls target and localized label. Focus and selection are separate states here; the local focused variable is a selected-type match. No keyboard, RTL, screen-reader or computed-accessibility run occurred, so this is an exact source contract rather than a general conformance claim.
title: Calendar view tabs move focus separately from activating a view
